name: selfEmployeeTrainingNeedApplication
description: Lets an Employee submit a training need application for themselves - either attaching it to an already-existing need category (existingNeedName) or describing a brand new one (newNeedName/newNeedDescription). The objective is either free text, or linked to one of the employee's ongoing performance goals via goalTitle - set enableGoalObjectives to browse the current goal list first if the exact title isn't already known. Relevance to job and the two benefits are collected only if the server demands them (per-client config). On every turn the user attaches a file, call this tool on that same turn (the chat passes a file's contents only then); files are added (several allowed) if they match PeoplesHR's allowed types and size - take one off with removeAttachments, or swap with replaceAttachments. Call with confirmed unset first for a preview and the real confirmation prompt, then again with confirmed:true, before anything is validated or saved. Write tool - submits a real application on success.
